def __register_types(self):
        """Iterates all entry points for resource types and registers a `resource_type_id` to class mapping

        Returns:
            `None`
        """
        for entry_point in iter_entry_points(group='mangum.resource_types'):
            resource_type_id = entry_point.name
            resource_type_class = entry_point.load()
            self.resource_types[resource_type_id] = resource_type_class
